uap@8.6.11.18870.source: 0xE7FCFEBF, captured from a real UniFi AP reporting firmware 8.6.11.18870 (gneitzke/UnifiOptimizer, model UAPA6A9). Measured against controller 10.4.57 by TestClassicAPFirmwareCapsProbeLive: rebuilds port_table from 4 keys to 17 and drops port_stats, breaks no write that works on the placeholder, and unblocks an empty port_overrides PUT

ugw@4.4.57.5578372.source: 0x0042D003, captured from a real USG-3P reporting firmware 4.4.57.5578372 (jdrew82/nautobot-app-ssot-unifi fixtures, model UGW3). Sets neither UTERM nor QCASWITCH. Measured against controller 10.4.57: no observable change at all, and all five probe writes keep succeeding

US648P.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-enterprise-48-poe: 48x 2.5GbE RJ45 (all PoE+) + 4x 10G SFP+ = 52 ports. The bundle says plus 49-54, contradicting its own numberOfPorts of 52

US68P.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-enterprise-8-poe: the 2 uplinks are 10G SFP+, not 1G SFP

USM8P.source: USW-Ultra PoE++ input is 1GbE RJ45, not SFP+

USM8P210.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-ultra-210w: 8 GbE RJ45 (7 PoE+, 1 PoE++ input) and no SFP cage; the bundle files the PoE++ input under "plus" as it does on USM8P

USM8P60.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-ultra-60w: 8 GbE RJ45 (7 PoE+, 1 PoE++ input) and no SFP cage; the bundle files the PoE++ input under "plus" as it does on USM8P

USPM48.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-pro-max-48 lists no PoE row at all; the PSE is on the separate USW-Pro-Max-48-PoE SKU (USPM48P). The bundle and the fingerprint DB both mark this one PoE-capable

USWED36.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-flex-2-5g-8: 8x 2.5GbE RJ45 + a 10GbE RJ45 / 10G SFP+ combo pair. The bundle records both halves of the pair as copper

USWED37.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-flex-2-5g-8-poe: 8x 2.5GbE RJ45 (PoE++) + a 10GbE RJ45 / 10G SFP+ combo pair. The bundle records both halves of the pair as copper

USWF004.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/ecs-24s-poe: the 24 access ports are RJ45 (8x 2.5GbE + 16x 10GbE), all PoE+++, not SFP+

USWF005.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/ecs-24s: the 24 access ports are RJ45 (8x 2.5GbE + 16x 10GbE), not SFP+

USXG24.source: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-enterprisexg-24: the 2 uplinks are 25G SFP28, not 10G SFP+

UXBSDM.source: nss by analogy with UWB-XG (techspecs.ui.com/unifi/wifi/uwb-xg, 4x4): the black SKU has no tech-specs page of its own, and fingerprint e585 carries the same radio block as e580

UXGENT.source: help.ui.com/hc/en-us/articles/16271338193559 (UniFi BGP): of the gateways that adopt by inform, only UXG-Enterprise supports BGP, on firmware 4.1.8 or newer. Every other device on that list (EFG, EF-Core, UDM/UCG/UDW) is a standalone console that runs the Network app and never adopts, so none are in this catalog
